context: Tests whether the agent correctly identifies that poetry.lock should take precedence over requirements.txt for version extraction, maps the manifest to the python language, and invokes the Meterian CLI. CLI invocation verified via Meterian-specific format in scan-raw.json rather than unverifiable command strings.

checklist.name: python language
checklist.description: Entries in `scan-raw.json` carry `"language":"python"` — confirming the correct language parameter was used (not `py`, `pip`, or `python3`)

checklist.name: Lock file preferred
checklist.description: Extracts dependency versions from `poetry.lock` rather than the version ranges in `requirements.txt`

checklist.name: Pinned versions used
checklist.description: The versions in `scan-raw.json` match the pinned versions in poetry.lock (e.g. django 2.2.4, requests 2.22.0) — not the lower-bound ranges from requirements.txt (e.g. django 2.0)

checklist.name: Raw scan data file
checklist.description: A file named `scan-raw.json` exists containing a JSON object with a `vulnerable` array — the Meterian CLI check output format

checklist.name: Meterian format: safeVersions
checklist.description: Entries in the `vulnerable` array of `scan-raw.json` contain a `safeVersions` field — a distinctive Meterian-only field not produced by pip-audit or web search

checklist.name: Markdown table
checklist.description: Report contains a markdown table with audit results and all five required column headers: Package, Version, Severity, ID, and Safe Version(s) — singular or plural accepted

checklist.name: Summary line
checklist.description: Report includes a summary line referencing total vulnerabilities found and count of clean packages
